provenance.method: Live-verified against api.featherless.ai: GET /v1/models for real per-MTok pricing, then one real chat/completions probe per (model, kind) using the exact runtime request shape (per-kind system prompt, temperature 0, seed 42, runtime max_tokens 32/256/256/128), requiring non-empty content that passes the worker's verify() shape checks.
findings: v1-live's promoted long-tail fine-tunes were absent from the runtime catalog and mostly unservable (representative cheap long-tail probe returned 400 insufficient-capacity), so every kind silently ran on rung-1 GLM-5.2.
meta-llama Llama-3.2-1B/3B and 3.1-8B Instruct return 403 (HF gating not connected on this account) despite being listed.
Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B (reasoning family) returns EMPTY content at runtime budgets 32/128/256 (finish_reason=length, budget consumed by think blocks) — excluded from rung 0.
Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct and Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct passed all probed kinds at $0.04/$0.08 per MTok (in/out) — ~30x cheaper than GLM-5.2 output.
zai-org/GLM-5.2 real price is $0.75/$2.40 per MTok (catalog previously claimed $2.50/$10.00); fixture corrected.

mlabonne/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-abliterated was servable and marginally cheaper ($0.035/$0.065) but was not promoted: long-tail warmth churns (the exact failure this revision repairs) and an uncensored finetune is not a safe default.
v3Findings: 2026-08-15 roster widening: live /v1/models re-fetched (799 models on plan) and 11 candidates probed with a real ~20-token completion each (temp 0, seed 42, non-empty content required; reasoning-family models probed at max_tokens 768).
FAIL: google/gemma-2-2b-it and gemma-2-9b-it both 403 (HF-gated, org not connected) — gemma-2-2b not added; gemma-2-9b marked off-plan in the catalog.

Catalog prices/context corrected against live /v1/models for every listed entry; entries absent from the live listing (incl. deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-Lite, which does not exist on Featherless) marked availableOnPlan=false.
gpt-oss-20b/120b report features.tool_use=false on Featherless — servable for non-tool subtasks only; catalog toolUse corrected accordingly.
provenance.alternatesNote: route.ts's rung selection slices ladders[kind][0] (rung 0) and [1] (rung 1) — the schema effectively supports exactly 2 rungs. The new models are therefore wired as per-kind `alternates` (servability-verified, ordered by preference) for roster display and manual promotion, and the proven 2-rung ladders are left untouched. Alternates are NOT routed to at runtime.
provenance.note: quality/qualityCI are intentionally empty: rung-0 picks are servability-verified (shape-level verify() pass on live probes), not re-graded against gold labels. The v1 graded scores applied only to the now-delisted long-tail models.
